snippet.title: The Cold War in ASCII | Third Bloc — Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist Third Bloc on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5155860/Third_Bloc/?utm_source=youtube

Run your own republic through the Cold War, brought to life in animated ASCII.

Third Bloc is a text-based political strategy sandbox. Build your economy, negotiate with rival superpowers, send agents abroad, and pursue your ambitions in space and nuclear technology.

Factories or missiles? Foreign aid or independence? Your republic, your decisions.

Developed by ASCII Interactions.

#ThirdBloc #StrategyGames #ASCII
